title: DeSave
tagline: DeSave - A Public Goods Funding Dapp for Local Area Development.
description: DeSave - is an innovative approach that harnesses blockchain technology and decentralized decision-making to support the creation and maintenance of public goods. Unlike traditional funding models that rely on taxation or government allocation, decentralized funding allows individuals and communities to directly contribute resources to projects that benefit the general public. Through platforms like blockchain-based crowdfunding, decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs), token curated registries (TCRs), and quadratic funding mechanisms, the process becomes more transparent, accountable, and inclusive. By empowering communities to collectively decide on resource allocation and bypassing intermediaries, decentralized public goods funding promotes a more democratic and efficient way of supporting initiatives that serve the common good.
how_its_made:
DeSave uses World ID for secure and unique identifiers of users signing in to DeSave and the same is stored in the smart contract
It uses UMA Oracle to verify the eligibility of the user to withdraw from a current ongoing project. 
DeSave uses subgraph to index the events of the smart contract
